Karte Te Sarwar Buka, Hai Kamar Jhukgai
Mergaya Bhayi Mera Hai Kamar Jhukgai

1
Mergai Hum Jeteji, Chut Gai Hum Se Aki
Hogai Bazo Juda, Hai Kamar Jhukgai

2
Kuwaate Bazo Tha Wo, Kalb Ki Takat Thaw Wo
Hogai Hum Be Nawa, Hai Kamar Jhukgai

3
Le Chalo Akbar Waha, Bhai He Mera Jaha
Jald Chalo Mehlaka, Hai Kamar Jhukgai

4
Dar Me Kari Beqarar, Kurte He Wo Intezar
Usse Kahunga Me Kya, Hai Kamar Jhukgai

5
Pyass Se Sub Hai Nidhaal, Pani Ka Hoga Sawaal
Kehna Wo Sab Behgaya, Hai Kamar Jhukgai

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check -- src/data/lyrics/haye-kamar-jhuk-gayi.md && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/haye-kamar-jhuk-gayi.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---', 2)[2].strip()
_, meta, body = Path(p).read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = '\\n'.join(line.removeprefix('  ') for line in meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].strip('\\n').splitlines())
assert old.casefold() == roman.casefold()
source = body.strip().translate(str.maketrans('۱۲۳۴۵', '12345'))
assert [len(b.splitlines()) for b in source.split('\\n\\n')] == [2, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3]
assert [b.splitlines()[0] for b in source.split('\\n\\n')[1:]] == list('12345')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu script in [haye-kamar-jhuk-gayi.md](src/data/lyrics/haye-kamar-jhuk-gayi.md). Preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics` with sentence-case capitalization, set the direction to RTL, and removed the `noUrdu` tag. Both versions have a two-line opening and five two-line stanzas.

The unclear Roman word `aki` is rendered phonetically as `اکی`.
